name: kabuki-start
description: The smallest Kabuki Start app, the one to copy: static, dynamic and client pages layered on one screen, links that preload on hover, two API Workers with a public, an authenticated and an authorized call each, and a Pocket of wallets kept on the device with Replica, published at start.kishore.app.

scripts.dev: vp run --filter 'kabuki-start^...' build && portless alias hello-http-start.kishore 4581 --force && portless alias hello-rpc-start.kishore 4582 --force && portless alias pocket-start.kishore 4583 --force && portless run --force alchemy dev
